sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
jina: Conditions for withdrawal of money from the Consolidated Fund
maudhui: (1) Money shall not be withdrawn from the Consolidated Fund for the purpose of expenditure except in accordance with the following conditions— (a) the money is for expenditure which is charged upon the Consolidated Fund and such charge is authorized by this Constitution or any other law; or (b) the money is for expenditure which has been authorized either by an Appropriation Act enacted specially by Parliament or by a law enacted pursuant to the provisions of Article 140 of this Constitution. (2) Money standing to the credit of any special fund of the Government, other than the Consolidated Fund, shall not be withdrawn from that fund for expenditure unless such expenditure has been authorized by law. (3) Money standing to the credit of the Consolidated Fund shall not be withdrawn from that Fund for expenditure unless such expenditure has been authorized by the Controller and Auditor-General, and provided that such money shall be withdrawn in accordance with the procedure prescribed for that purpose by a law enacted by Parliament.
